subject: Sexually Dimorphic Longevity and Muscle Preservation under Dietary Restriction
script: From Agewell Brief: Sexually Dimorphic Longevity and Muscle Preservation under Dietary Restriction. New findings in Nothobranchius furzeri reveal that caloric scarcity drives divergent, sex-specific bioenergetic adaptations in lifespan and somatic maintenance. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
